source: https://github.com/C2SP/C2SP/blob/fea9004f73fbec8cf7a8b1936430e2487eb23b55/tlog-tiles.md (the worked index 1234067 and the path grammar) and https://github.com/golang/mod/blob/b5136e5ba156da612a1efc6e49b55988a134a5e0/sumdb/tlog/tlog_test.go (tilePaths). Go's paths carry a tile height element and C2SP's do not, so each Go row is written here with that element removed and its height-8 width. `level` null is an entry bundle. The first three `invalid` rows are Go's; the rest are this tree's, each breaking one rule of the C2SP path grammar.
